card.name: Offshore locations and sea geography
card.fires_on: Words that place something at sea or off a coast, such as "off", "of" after southwest, "coast", "offshore" and "Bay". It appears in news and geography text about oceans, islands and quakes.

modes.label: Off the coast
modes.description: Position words like off, of or coast that place an event or object at sea near a named shore.
modes.example: Magnitude 6.5 quake hits<< off>> coast of Japan, tsunami warning issued

modes.label: Sea and island names
modes.description: Ocean, bay or offshore-island words in geographic descriptions.
modes.example: Los Angeles County also includes two<< offshore>> islands, San Clemente Island and Santa

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
